trigger: An installed wildcard HTTP deployment has no authentication base URL, and its updater must still resolve an operator origin to verify.
observedFailure: Setting MOONMIND_PUBLIC_BASE_URL only for release verification changes authentication configuration and makes candidate API startup reject non-loopback HTTP.
expected: A wildcard binding verifies the loopback origin it already publishes on, so the default update needs no declaration; explicit operator origins in the immutable release submission add routes without changing installed API authentication or bindings, and every configured authentication origin remains a required probe target.
